_meta.legend_rw: R=read, W=writes/mutates peer state, RW=both, mint=issues an auth token
_meta.note: calls = VERIFIED runtime service edges (a real client call site exists). Nodes keyed by service; keys starting with _ are metadata. _dead_env = URL read from env but never called (NOT a dependency). _indirect = not a runtime call by this service (config injected into the agent, which makes the call).
_meta.fork_rule: A forked service falling through to a baseline peer is safe for R edges; W edges MUTATE baseline state (create projects/deploys, mint identities, publish templates, consume pool agents) and must be isolated or explicitly accepted.

_dead_env.why: INTERVIX_MCP_URL only injected into the agent MCP bootstrap; brahmi never calls intervix
LOUIE_BROKER_ADDR only seeded into agent env; louie/pkg/peerpool is a vendored brahmi<->brahmi clustering lib
JUNO_MCP_URL only injected into the agent MCP bootstrap
ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL rewritten to point agents at mang-proxy; brahmi makes no direct Anthropic call
GitanaClient constructed but DispatchWorkflow has zero callers
VITE_JUMBO_BASE_URL has no consumer in src; jumbo reached only via brahmi
JUMBO_ADDR referenced only in e2e tests; no production dial
inbound only: brahmi calls the ec2mock AWS API; ec2mock never dials brahmi

_indirect.via: injects BRAHMI_URL into the agent service-config (jumbo/service_config.go)
_indirect.note: the provisioned AGENT calls brahmi, not pool-manager; to route pooled agents at a fork, change this injected value

_indirect.via: injects IKKI_GRPC_ADDR into the aramb-browser service-config
